items.label: Confirm moving date with landlord/agent
items.tip: Get written confirmation of your move-out and move-in dates.

items.label: Book professional removals company
items.tip: Get at least 3 quotes. Weekend slots book up 4-6 weeks ahead.

items.label: Notify utility providers of move date
items.tip: Gas, electric, water, broadband — arrange final readings and disconnection.

items.label: Redirect post with Royal Mail
items.tip: Set up mail redirection for at least 3 months. Costs from £33.99.

items.label: Declutter and sort belongings
items.tip: Donate, sell, or dispose of items you won't take. Start room by room.

items.label: Book professional deep cleaning of premises
items.tip: End-of-tenancy cleans are more thorough. Most agencies require professional receipt.

items.label: Arrange professional end-of-tenancy inventory check
items.tip: Independent inventory clerk protects your deposit. £100-£200 typical cost.

items.label: Start packing non-essential items
items.tip: Label boxes by room. Use wardrobe boxes for clothes — no need to fold.

items.label: Hire professional painters for final touch-ups
items.tip: Scuff marks on walls? A quick touch-up can save deposit deductions.

items.label: Update council tax and electoral roll
items.tip: Notify your local council of your move-in and move-out dates.

items.label: Pack and coordinate heavy furniture transfer
items.tip: Disassemble large furniture. Photograph condition before wrapping.

items.label: Change primary external security cylinders
items.tip: New home? Change locks immediately. You don't know who has copies.

items.label: Take final meter readings
items.tip: Photograph all meters with timestamp. Send to utility companies same day.

items.label: Set up home surveillance and security alarm
items.tip: Get CCTV or alarm installed before furniture arrives.

items.label: Defrost freezer and clean white goods
items.tip: Turn off 24 hours before. Leave doors open to prevent mould.

items.label: Final walkthrough with landlord/agent
items.tip: Do this together. Photograph every room, wall, floor, and appliance.

items.label: Hand over all keys and fobs
items.tip: Get written receipt. Include window keys, shed keys, parking permits.

items.label: Coordinate waste disposal of packing materials
items.tip: Flatten boxes. Book a collection if you have large volumes.

items.label: Check new property utilities are working
items.tip: Test hot water, heating, electrics, and internet. Report issues immediately.

items.label: Register with new GP and dentist
items.tip: NHS registration can take weeks. Register online as soon as you have proof of address.
